name: How should I prepare before consulting a contractor for a primary suite addition?
description: Locate your property survey, define must-have bathroom and storage features, establish a target budget, and note any specific layout preferences.

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare before consulting a contractor for a primary suite addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before meeting with a remodeling contractor, gather your property survey or plot plan, identify your primary goals, and set a preliminary budget range. Knowing your property boundaries helps determine feasible expansion areas without encroaching on setback lines. It is also helpful to make a list of priorities—such as whether you require a zero-entry walk-in shower, double vanities, or private access to a back patio. Having these details ready allows the builder to provide realistic layout options and project estimates.
